issues.title: Login fails on Safari when SSO is enabled
issues.description: Users on Safari 17 are sent back to the sign-in page after finishing the SSO handshake. Third-party cookie partitioning appears to drop the session cookie.

issues.title: Dashboard charts flicker on window resize
issues.description: The revenue and usage charts re-render several times while the browser window is being resized, which causes a visible flicker on low-powered laptops.

issues.title: CSV export truncates reports beyond 10,000 rows
issues.description: Exporting a large report silently stops at 10,000 rows with no warning. Expected behaviour is to stream the full dataset or tell the user the export is partial.

issues.title: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page
issues.description: Several customers have asked for a persistent dark mode preference. The toggle should follow the OS setting by default and remember the user's choice.

issues.title: Password reset email arrives after 15 minutes
issues.description: Transactional emails are queued behind marketing sends. Reset links expire after 10 minutes, so many users can never complete the flow.

issues.title: Typo in the onboarding checklist tooltip
issues.description: The tooltip on step 3 reads “Invte teammates”. A simple copy fix that needs to land in every supported locale.

issues.title: Notification badge count is out of sync
issues.description: After marking all notifications as read on mobile, the desktop badge still shows the old unread count until the page is refreshed manually.

issues.title: Rate limiter blocks legitimate API bursts
issues.description: Partners running nightly syncs hit 429 responses even though they stay under the documented quota. The sliding-window calculation needs a review.

issues.title: Search index misses newly created projects
issues.description: Projects created within the last hour do not appear in global search. The indexing worker seems to lag behind under load.

issues.title: Improve keyboard navigation in data tables
issues.description: Arrow-key navigation between cells is inconsistent and focus is lost after sorting a column. Needs an audit against the WAI-ARIA grid pattern.

issues.title: Avatar upload rejects valid PNG files
issues.description: PNG images with an embedded colour profile fail validation with a generic error message. Files up to 5 MB should be accepted.

issues.title: Billing page shows the wrong currency for EU accounts
issues.description: Invoices for Eurozone accounts are displayed with a USD symbol although they are charged in EUR. Only the summary card is affected, not the PDF.
